column1: # *** AVELINO'S DATES ARE THE BIGGEST GAIN. *** Born 1815 and dead on 22 August 1890 - so he was
# alive when his son Alfredo Justiniano was baptised in 1858 and dead before Alfredo married in 1892,
# which is why AMBROSIA TRAIBEL stood witness at that wedding rather than her husband. Three records
# now lock together.
# *** AND JUSTA PASTORA'S MARRIAGE IS DATED: 3 NOVEMBER 1830, at the CORDON. *** Her first child was
# baptised at the same parish on 13 December 1831 - the act at which FRUCTUOSO RIVERA, President of
# the Republic, stood godfather. Thirteen months between the wedding and that font.
# ================ *** THE CAUTION ON DOMINGA - RAISED AND CLOSED THE SAME DAY *** ================
# This file was written in the morning with two records naming a DOMINGA, daughter of Sancho and Maria
# Fernandez, with DIFFERENT HUSBANDS - Antonio Rodriguez and Antonio Ruiz de Carvallo - and refused to
# merge them, because this archive had been caught twice by that shape. Both images were then opened.
# *** THE TWO HUSBANDS ARE ONE MAN. ***
#   1827, Catedral de Montevideo, baptism of LUCINDA GREGORIA: "hija legitima del CAPITAN DON ANTONIO
#        RUIZ DE CARVALLO y de Dona DOMINGA LLERENA DE CARVALLO. Nieta Paterna del MAYOR DON JOAQUIN
#        RUIZ DE CARVALLO ... Materna de SANCHO LLERENA y de Dona MARIA FERNANDEZ."
#   1840, the same Catedral, baptism of DOMINGO: "hijo legitimo de D. ANTONIO RODRIGUEZ DE CARBALLO,
#        natural de la PROVINCIA DEL RIO GRANDE, y de Dona DOMINGA LERENA ... Nieto paterno de D.
#        JOAQUIN RODRIGUEZ ... y por parte materna de D. SANCHO LERENA y de Dona MARIA FERNANDEZ."
# Same Antonio, same father Joaquin, same wife, same wife's parents. The registers write his first
# surname RUIZ in 1827 and RODRIGUEZ in 1840, and the INDEX turned that into two husbands.
# *** SO: ONE DOMINGA. *** Born 13 May 1804 at Canelones; married ANTONIO DE CARVALLO; children LUCINDA
# GREGORIA (b. 24 Apr 1827) and DOMINGO (b. 4 Aug 1840), thirteen years apart, so probably others
# between. *** And she is almost certainly the "DONA DOMINGA CARVALLO" who stood godmother at Alberto
# Octavio Lerena's baptism in 1850 *** - a Lerena by birth standing for her brother's son.
# *** THE DISCIPLINE IS WHAT PRODUCED THIS, and it is worth saying plainly: *** the two records were
# kept apart until an act joined them, rather than merged because both husbands were called Antonio.
# Had they been merged on the resemblance, the right answer would have been reached for the wrong
# reason - and the next resemblance would have been merged too.
# *** TWO DISCREPANCIES RECORDED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED AWAY. *** 1827 makes Antonio a CAPITAN and his
# father a MAYOR, and names the mother DONA JUANA SUAREZ, "la finada". 1840 gives no ranks, makes
# Antonio a native of RIO GRANDE in Brazil with parents from the COLONIA DEL SACRAMENTO, and names the
# mother DONA JUANA DEL ESPIRITU SANTO. A devotional epithet and a surname can belong to one woman -
# Juana del Espiritu Santo Suarez - and that is a READING, not a finding.
